questions.question: There are 45 students in a hostel. If the number of students increases by 5, the total expenses of the mess increase by ₹30 per day while the average daily expenditure per head diminishes by ₹2. Find the original total daily expenditure of the mess.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

No. of students in a hostel = 45 

When 5 students increase average daily expenditure per head decreases by Rs 2

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of values/ No. of values

**Calculation:**

Let, the average expenditure initially was Rsx 

⇒ Total expenditure/number of students = Average 

⇒ Total expenditure/45 = x 

⇒ Total expenditure = 45x

Now, when 5 more students joined, total expenditure becomes ( 45x + 30)

⇒ Now, the average expenditure = Sum of values/ No. of values = (45x + 30)/(45 +5) = (45x +30)/50

Now, According to the given Question average daily expenditure diminishes by Rs2

Hence, the average becomes (x - 2)

⇒ (45x +30) / 50 = x-2 

⇒ 45x +30 = 50x - 100

⇒ 130 = 5x 

⇒ x = Rs 26

⇒ Original total daily expenditure = 45 × 26 = Rs 1,170.

**Hence, the original total daily expenditure was Rs 1,170.**

questions.question: Let r be the greatest number which when divides 41, 71 and 91 leaves the same remainder. Find the LCM of r and 45.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Divisor r leaving the same remainder = HCF of |x − y|, |y − z|, and |z − x|.

r = HCF of |71 − 41|, |91 − 71|, and |91 − 41|

r = HCF(30, 20, 50) = 10

Required LCM = LCM of 10 and 45 = 90

**∴ The correct answer is 90.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three numbers: 41, 71, and 91

Second number to find LCM with r: 45

**Concept Used:**

The greatest number r that divides x, y, and z leaving the same remainder is the HCF of their absolute differences.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Differences = |71 − 41|, |91 − 71|, and |91 − 41|

⇒ Differences = 30, 20, and 50

⇒ Now, we find the HCF of 30, 20, and 50 to get r.

⇒ 30 = 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ 20 = 2² × 5

⇒ 50 = 2 × 5²

⇒ Common prime factors are 2 and 5.

⇒ r = HCF(30, 20, 50) = 2 × 5 = 10

⇒ We need to find the LCM of r (which is 10) and 45.

⇒ 10 = 2 × 5

⇒ 45 = 3² × 5

⇒ LCM(10, 45) = 2 × 3² × 5

⇒ LCM = 2 × 9 × 5 = 90

**∴ The correct answer is 90.**

**__Additional Information__**

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

The greatest number that perfectly divides two or more numbers. It is obtained by multiplying the lowest powers of all common prime factors.

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The smallest number which is perfectly divisible by two or more given numbers. It is the product of the highest powers of all prime factors involved.

Property of Remainder Divisors

When asked to find the greatest number dividing x, y, and z to leave the same remainder, the required number is always the HCF of the absolute differences |x − y|, |y − z|, and |z − x|.
</p

questions.question: If (sin θ+cos θ)/(sin θ-cos θ)=3, then the value of sin⁴ θ - cos⁴ θ is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply **Componendo and Dividendo**: (sin θ + cos θ + sin θ − cos θ) ÷ (sin θ + cos θ − (sin θ − cos θ)) = (3 + 1) ÷ (3 − 1).

⇒ 2 sin θ ÷ 2 cos θ = 4 ÷ 2 ⇒ tan θ = 2.

Using **Right Triangle**: perpendicular = 2, base = 1, hypotenuse = √(2² + 1²) = √5.

sin⁴ θ − cos⁴ θ = (sin² θ − cos² θ)(sin² θ + cos² θ) = sin² θ − cos² θ = (2/√5)² − (1/√5)² = 4/5 − 1/5 = 3/5.

**∴ The correct answer is 3/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (sin θ + cos θ) / (sin θ − cos θ) = 3

**Formula Used:** sin⁴ θ − cos⁴ θ = (sin² θ + cos² θ)(sin² θ − cos² θ); sin² θ + cos² θ = 1

⇒ sin θ + cos θ = 3(sin θ − cos θ)

⇒ sin θ + cos θ = 3 sin θ − 3 cos θ

⇒ 4 cos θ = 2 sin θ

⇒ tan θ = 2

⇒ sin θ = 2/√5 and cos θ = 1/√5

⇒ sin⁴ θ − cos⁴ θ = (sin² θ − cos² θ)(1)

⇒ (2/√5)² − (1/√5)² = 4/5 − 1/5 = 3/5

**∴ The correct answer is 3/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Fundamental identities include sin² θ + cos² θ = 1, 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ, and 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ.

Algebraic Difference of Powers

For even powers, a⁴ − b⁴ can be factored into (a² − b²)(a² + b²), which is very useful in trigonometric simplifications.

Componendo and Dividendo Rule

If a/b = c/d, then (a+b)/(a-b) = (c+d)/(c-d). This rule simplifies ratio-based trigonometric equations quickly.</p

questions.question: 40 men can complete a work in 15 days. They started working, and after 5 days 10 more men joined them. In how many days will the total work be completed?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = 40 × 15 = 600 man-days.

Remaining work after 5 days = 600 − (40 × 5) = 400 man-days.

Current workforce after 10 men join = 40 + 10 = 50 men.

Time required for the remaining work = 400 ÷ 50 = 8 days.

Total time to complete the work = 5 days + 8 days = 13 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 13 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

40 men can complete the work in 15 days.

After 5 days of working, 10 more men joined.

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time taken by 40 men to finish the whole work = 15 days.

⇒ Since time is inversely proportional to the number of men, time taken by 10 men = 15 × (40 ÷ 10) = 60 days.

⇒ Let's use the LCM method to find the total work units and individual group efficiencies:

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 40 Men
 15

 10 Men

⇒ Total efficiency of 50 men (40 + 10) = 4 + 1 = 5 units/day.

⇒ Work completed by 40 men in the first 5 days = Efficiency × Days = 4 × 5 = 20 units.

⇒ Remaining work = Total Work − Completed Work = 60 − 20 = 40 units.

⇒ Time taken by 50 men to complete the remaining work = Remaining Work ÷ Total Efficiency = 40 ÷ 5 = 8 days.

⇒ Total time to complete the whole work = Initial 5 days + 8 days = 13 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 13 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: A book published in 2025, authored by Narendra Modi and titled 'The Emergency Diaries – Years That Forged a Leader', is thematically associated with which of the following periods in Indian political history?
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is '1975–1977'**

The book titled **'The Emergency Diaries – Years That Forged a Leader'**, authored by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, is a significant literary work that reflects on one of the most controversial periods in post-independence Indian history: the National Emergency. The book is set to be released around the 50th anniversary of the imposition of the Emergency, providing a personal and political account of the events that transpired during that era.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1975–1977 (The Emergency Period):**

 
 
• The National Emergency was declared by President Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed on the recommendation of Prime Minister Indira Gandhi on June 25, 1975, and lasted until March 21, 1977.
 
• This period was characterized by the suspension of fundamental rights, censorship of the press, and the imprisonment of several political leaders and activists.
 
• Narendra Modi, who was a young RSS (Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh) pracharak at the time, played an active role in the underground movement against the Emergency.
 
• The book 'The Emergency Diaries' chronicles his experiences, observations, and the lessons learned during these 21 months, which he describes as formative years for his political leadership.
 
• The narrative focuses on the resistance movement, the fight for the restoration of democracy, and the socio-political climate of India during the mid-1970s.
 
 

**Additional Information__**

__
 
• **1962–1965:**

 
 
• This period in Indian history was marked by major external conflicts, including the **Indo-China War of 1962** and the **Indo-Pakistani War of 1965**.
 
• It saw the end of the Jawaharlal Nehru era (1964) and the leadership of Lal Bahadur Shastri, who gave the famous slogan "Jai Jawan Jai Kisan." This period is not associated with the internal political crackdown described in the book.
 
 
 
• **1989–1991:**
 
 
• This was a period of extreme political instability and economic transition in India, often called the "Era of Coalition Politics."
 
• Key events included the implementation of the **Mandal Commission** report, the assassination of Rajiv Gandhi, and the beginning of **Economic Liberalization** under P.V. Narasimha Rao in 1991. While transformative, it is distinct from the Emergency era.
 
 
 
• **1969–1971:**
 
 
• This timeframe was defined by the **split of the Indian National Congress** in 1969 and the subsequent rise of Indira Gandhi's dominance.
 
• The year 1971 was particularly significant due to the **Indo-Pakistani War** which led to the creation of Bangladesh and Indira Gandhi's landslide victory in the general elections under the "Garibi Hatao" slogan.
 
 

**Important Points__**

 
• The National Emergency was invoked under **Article 352** of the Indian Constitution on the grounds of "internal disturbance."
 
• During this time, Narendra Modi worked incognito, often using disguises (such as a Sikh man) to avoid arrest while coordinating protest activities and distributing anti-government literature.
 
• The release of this book in 2025 serves as a historical record from a contemporary leader's perspective, emphasizing the importance of democratic values and institutional integrity.
 
• The Emergency ended in 1977 when Indira Gandhi called for fresh elections, resulting in a historic defeat for the Congress party and the formation of the first non-Congress government at the center by the Janata Party.

questions.question: Twelve years ago, Rekha's age was 2/5 of that of her sister. The ratio of Rekha's and her sister's present age is 4 ∶ 7. What is the total of their present ages?
questions.solution:

Present Age Ratio of **Rekha** and **Sister** = 4 : 7

Total Ratio parts = 4 + 7 = 11 units.

Since the total age must be a multiple of 11, check the options.

Only 44 and 66 are multiples of 11. Using 12 years ago ratio 2 : 5:

If Total = 66, then ages are 24 and 42. 12 years ago: (24−12) : (42−12) = 12 : 30 = 2 : 5. (Matches)

**∴ The correct answer is 66 years.**

Present age ratio = 4 : 7

Calculate the value of frac{{Range}}{{Median}} for the set of data given below:

134, 98, 194, 122, 108, 156
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Arrange **data** in ascending order: 98, 108, 122, 134, 156, 194.

**Range** = Maximum − Minimum = 194 − 98 = 96.

**Median** (n=6) = Average of 3rd and 4th terms = (122 + 134) ÷ 2 = 128.

Required **Value** = Range ÷ Median = 96 ÷ 128 = 3/4.

**∴ The correct answer is 3/4.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given data:** 134, 98, 194, 122, 108, 156

**Step 1:** Sort the data set: 98, 108, 122, 134, 156, 194.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21b55df67db8f5b0ccb322f3f9e55795db964d2613acb4e2fee9f94c0268d440.png] 

**Step 2: Calculate Range**

⇒ **Range** = Largest value − Smallest value

⇒ **Range** = 194 − 98 = 96

**Step 3: Calculate Median**

⇒ Number of observations (n) = 6 (even)

⇒ **Median** = [(n/2)th term + (n/2 + 1)th term] ÷ 2

⇒ **Median** = [3rd term + 4th term] ÷ 2

⇒ **Median** = (122 + 134) ÷ 2 = 256 ÷ 2 = 128

**Step 4: Calculate Range ÷ Median**

⇒ Ratio = 96 ÷ 128

⇒ Ratio = (32 × 3) ÷ (32 × 4)

⇒ Ratio = 3/4

**∴ The correct answer is 3/4.**

**__Additional Information__**

Median for Even and Odd Data

For odd n, Median = ((n+1)/2)th term. For even n, Median = average of (n/2)th and (n/2+1)th terms.

Range in Statistics

The **Range** is the simplest measure of dispersion and is calculated as the difference between the **Maximum** and **Minimum** observations.

Coefficient of Range

Coefficient of Range = (Max − Min) ÷ (Max + Min). It is a relative measure of dispersion.</p

questions.question: The sum of five numbers A, B, C, D and E is 37.5. The average of A and B is 6, and the average of D and E is 9. The average of A, B and C is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **sum of all five numbers** A, B, C, D, and E is given as 37.5.

The **sum of D and E** is 2 × 9 = 18.

Subtract the sum of D and E from the total sum to find the **sum of A, B, and C**: 37.5 − 18 = 19.5.

The **average of A, B, and C** is the sum divided by 3: 19.5 ÷ 3 = 6.5.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.5.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of five numbers (A + B + C + D + E) = 37.5

Average of A and B = 6

Average of D and E = 9

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of observations

Average = Sum ÷ Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d61f9deff71744e67dd683b3cdab22a0b6566cab0c5d898c55c387c456b5feb3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of A and B = 2 × 6 = 12

⇒ Sum of D and E = 2 × 9 = 18

⇒ Substitute these in the total sum equation: (A + B) + C + (D + E) = 37.5

⇒ 12 + C + 18 = 37.5

⇒ 30 + C = 37.5

⇒ C = 37.5 − 30 = 7.5

⇒ Sum of A, B, and C = (A + B) + C = 12 + 7.5 = 19.5

⇒ Average of A, B, and C = 19.5 ÷ 3 = 6.5

**∴ The correct answer is 6.5.**

**__Additional Information__**

Basic Average Formula

The average of n numbers is calculated as (Sum of all n numbers) ÷ n.

Relationship between Sum and Average

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations. This is used to find individual components when the total is known.

Weighted Average

When combining groups, the combined average is (n₁ × Avg₁ + n₂ × Avg₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p

questions.question: The average of 41 numbers is 58. The average of the first 16 numbers is 46 and the average of the last 26 numbers is 66. If the 16th number from the beginning is excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Base **Average** = 58

Deviation of **first 16 numbers** = 16 × (46 − 58) = −192

Deviation of **last 26 numbers** = 26 × (66 − 58) = +208

Net Deviation (which is the excess of the 16th number) = +208 − 192 = **+16**

New Average = Old Average − (Net Deviation ÷ Remaining Count) = 58 − (16 ÷ 40) = 58 − 0.4 = **57.6**

**∴ The correct answer is 57.6.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total numbers (n) = **41**, Average = **58**

First 16 numbers average = **46**

Last 26 numbers average = **66**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3269829a724828f4adca1b8cdde2352abdfd9eb846dacb2715091c5760a571a9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Sum of 41 numbers = 41 × 58 = **2378**

⇒ Sum of first 16 numbers = 16 × 46 = **736**

⇒ Sum of last 26 numbers = 26 × 66 = **1716**

⇒ Value of 16th number = (Sum of 16) + (Sum of 26) − Total Sum

⇒ 16th number = (736 + 1716) − 2378 = 2452 − 2378 = **74**

⇒ Sum of remaining 40 numbers = 2378 − 74 = **2304**

⇒ New average = 2304 ÷ 40 = **57.6**

**∴ The correct answer is 57.6.**

**__Additional Information__**

Overlapping Number Concept

When the sum of the parts exceeds the total count by 1, the overlapping value = (Sum of Group A + Sum of Group B) − Total Sum.

Effect of Excluded Value on Average

If the excluded value is greater than the original average, the new average will decrease. Change in Avg = (Average − Excluded Value) ÷ (New Count).

Deviation Method

Instead of calculating large sums, use net deviation from the assumed average to find specific values or new averages quickly.</p

questions.question: If 3x – 2y = 10 and xy = 11, the value of 27x³ - 8y³ is __________
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the identity: **a³ − b³ = (a − b)³ + 3ab(a − b)**

Here, a = 3x and b = 2y, so (a − b) = 10 and 3ab = 3(3x)(2y) = 18xy.

Substitute values: 10³ + 18(11)(10) = 1000 + 1980 = 2980.

**∴ The correct answer is 2980.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/426185eadd164bc16f551c60dec644e8c2497e9fe50c639ba1be0aa42ae437f1.png] 

Using the **algebraic identity** for cubes:

(a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)

Let a = 3x and b = 2y.

⇒ (3x − 2y)³ = (3x)³ − (2y)³ − 3(3x)(2y)(3x − 2y)

⇒ (3x − 2y)³ = 27x³ − 8y³ − 18xy(3x − 2y)

Substitute the **given values** into the equation:

⇒ (10)³ = 27x³ − 8y³ − 18 × 11 × 10

⇒ 1000 = 27x³ − 8y³ − 1980

⇒ 27x³ − 8y³ = 1000 + 1980

⇒ 27x³ − 8y³ = 2980

**∴ The correct answer is 2980.**

questions.question: If the LCM of two numbers a and b is 60 and their HCF is 15. Determine their mean proportion.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The product of two numbers is equal to the product of their LCM and HCF.

Product = 60 × 15 = 900

Mean proportion of two numbers is the square root of their product.

Mean proportion = √900 = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

LCM of a and b = 60

HCF of a and b = 15

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43a908ea2dc7e88b431deb67ade97f86de828182f291f2df087497ee9065b396.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Product of two numbers (a × b) = LCM × HCF

Mean Proportion of a and b = √(a × b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ a × b = 60 × 15

⇒ a × b = 900

⇒ Mean Proportion = √(a × b)

⇒ Mean Proportion = √900

⇒ Mean Proportion = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

**__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportion

The mean proportion between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b).

Third Proportion

The third proportion of two numbers a and b is a value c such that a : b = b : c, which gives c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportion

The fourth proportion of three numbers a, b, and c is a value d such that a : b = c : d, which gives d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Product Rule of Numbers

For any two positive integers, the product of the numbers is always equal to the product of their HCF and LCM.

questions.question: A reduction of 20% in the price of bananas enables a customer to buy 6 more bananas for ₹80. What is the reduced price of bananas per dozen (in ₹)?

⇒ 80/(4x/5)

⇒ 100/x

⇒ (100/x) – (80/x) = 6 

⇒ 20/x = 6 

⇒ x = 20/6

New price of bananas = 20/6 × 4/5

⇒ 8/3

The reduced price of bananas per dozen = (8/3) × 12

⇒ 32

**∴ The reduced price of bananas per dozen (in ₹) is 32.**

⇒ 4over x = 6

The new price of bananas is,

⇒ 4x = 4 ×2over3

questions.question: A sum becomes 27 times in 3 years, compounded annually at a certain rate of interest. Calculate annual interest rate.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **compounded annually** growth, use the root of the times-factor based on the **time period**.

Growth factor for 3 years = 27 times.

Annual growth factor = ³√27 = 3.

Rate (R) = (Annual Factor − 1) × 100% = (3 − 1) × 100% = 200%.

**∴ The correct answer is 200%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = P

**Amount (A)** = 27P

**Time (t)** = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)t

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34ee4724494690706a21abf3804daff494342e371bc0818d3a2a7a2fef55d62e.png] 

⇒ 27P = P(1 + R/100)³

⇒ 27 = (1 + R/100)³

⇒ (3)³ = (1 + R/100)³

⇒ 3 = 1 + R/100

⇒ R/100 = 3 − 1

⇒ R/100 = 2

⇒ R = 200%

**∴ The correct answer is 200%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Interest Rate

When interest is compounded more than once a year, the actual rate earned is Rₑff = [1 + (r/n)]ⁿ − 1, where 'n' is the number of compounding periods.

Difference between CI and SI

A quick shortcut to estimate the doubling time of an investment: Time ≈ 72 ÷ Rate of Interest.</p

questions.question: A is a working partner and B is a sleeping partner in a business. A invested ₹30,000 and B invested ₹50,000. A receives 20% of the profit for managing the business and the rest is divided in proportion to their capital. What does B get out of the profit of ₹10,000?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

B is a sleeping partner, so he receives his share only from the profit remaining after A's managing fee.

Investment Ratio of A and B = 30,000 : 50,000 = 3 : 5.

Remaining profit after A's 20% fee = 80% of ₹10,000 = ₹8,000.

B's share in profit = (5 / 8) × 8,000 = ₹5,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A's investment = ₹30,000

B's investment = ₹50,000

Total Profit = ₹10,000

A's managing fee = 20% of total profit

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9694767f66fe0342af9b6251008b376a1c3e692496b45a5d3effc0257afaf9be.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Profit is divided by capital ratio since both invested for the same duration.

⇒ Capital Ratio of A and B = 30,000 : 50,000 = 3 : 5

⇒ Total Ratio parts = 3 + 5 = 8 parts

⇒ A's managing fee = 20% of ₹10,000 = ₹2,000

⇒ Remaining divisible profit = 10,000 − 2,000 = ₹8,000

⇒ B's share = (B's ratio ÷ Total ratio) × Divisible profit

⇒ B's share = (5 ÷ 8) × 8,000

⇒ B's share = 5 × 1,000 = ₹5,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Working Partner vs Sleeping Partner

A **Working Partner** actively manages the business and usually receives a salary or fixed percentage of profit before the division. A **Sleeping Partner** only invests capital and receives a share only from the remaining divisible profit.

Partnership Profit Distribution

Profit ratio is equal to the product of Capital and Time invested: Profit Ratio = (C₁ × T₁) : (C₂ × T₂). If the time period is the same, profit is distributed directly in proportion to their initial capitals.

questions.question: The ratio of the age of A : C = 1 : 2, C : D = 2 : 3 and B : C = 5 : 6. If the difference in the age of B and D is 28, then find the average age of A and B.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Combine ratios **A : C : D** = 1 : 2 : 3 and **B : C** = 5 : 6.

To equalize **C**, multiply **A : C : D** by 3 → **A : B : C : D** = 3 : 5 : 6 : 9.

Difference between **D** and **B** = 9 − 5 = 4 units = **28 years** → 1 unit = **7 years**.

Average of **A** and **B** = (3 + 5) ÷ 2 = 4 units → 4 × 7 = **28 years**.

**∴ The correct answer is 28 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratios **A : C** = 1 : 2, **C : D** = 2 : 3, and **B : C** = 5 : 6. Age difference **D − B** = 28.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21490db25cde7c0ebd09127316e1b4912e786c6578c419d00629f3d468a6f6ca.png] 

⇒ Combining ratios: **A : C : D** = 1 : 2 : 3.

⇒ To link **B : C** (5 : 6), multiply **A : C : D** by 3: **A : C : D** = 3 : 6 : 9.

⇒ Combined Ratio **A : B : C : D** = 3 : 5 : 6 : 9.

⇒ Difference between **D** and **B**: 9x − 5x = 4x.

⇒ 4x = 28 ⇒ x = 7.

⇒ Average age of **A** and **B** = (3x + 5x) ÷ 2 = 8x ÷ 2 = 4x.

⇒ Average age = 4 × 7 = 28 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 28 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Balancing

To combine ratios like **a:b** and **b:c**, multiply the ratios by factors such that the common term **b** has the same value in both.

Average of Ratios

The average of two quantities represented as **mx** and **nx** is calculated as **(m + n)x ÷ 2**, provided they share the same common variable.

Age Difference Property

The difference between the ages of two people remains constant regardless of the number of years passed or the current reference point.</p

When two circles of equal radius (r) pass through each other's centre, the length of their common chord is given directly by the formula √3r.

**∴ The correct answer is 6√3 cm.**

**Given:**

Radius of both circles = r = 6 cm

The circles pass through each other's centre, implying the distance between their centres is exactly equal to their radius.

Distance between centres (AB) = 6 cm

**Concept Used:**

The line joining the centres of two intersecting circles acts as a perpendicular bisector to their common chord.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the centres of the two circles be A and B, and their intersection points be P and Q.

⇒ The distance AP = BP = r = 6 cm.

⇒ The distance AB = r = 6 cm.

⇒ Thus, ΔAPB is an equilateral triangle with a side length of 6 cm.

⇒ Let M be the point of intersection of the common chord PQ and the line AB.

⇒ Since PQ is perpendicularly bisected by AB, AM = AB ÷ 2 = 6 ÷ 2 = 3 cm.

⇒ In right-angled triangle ΔAMP, using the Pythagoras theorem:

⇒ AP² = AM² + PM²

⇒ 6² = 3² + PM²

⇒ 36 = 9 + PM²

⇒ PM² = 36 − 9 = 27

⇒ PM = √27 = 3√3 cm

⇒ The common chord PQ is exactly twice the length of PM.

⇒ PQ = 2 × PM = 2 × 3√3 = 6√3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 6√3 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Properties of Common Chord

The common chord of two intersecting circles is perpendicularly bisected by the straight line joining their centres. The maximum length of a common chord equals the diameter of the smaller circle.

Distance Between Centres of Intersecting Circles

If two circles with radii r₁ and r₂ intersect at two distinct points, the distance 'd' between their centres will always satisfy the strict inequality: |r₁ − r₂| < d < r₁ + r₂.

Number of Common Tangents

When two circles intersect each other at exactly two distinct points, exactly 2 direct common tangents can be drawn touching both circles, and no transverse common tangents exist.

questions.question: A boat can go 60 km downstream and 40 km upstream in 12 hours 30 minutes. It can go 84 km downstream and 63 km upstream in 18 hours 54 minutes. What is the speed (in km/h, to the nearest integer) of the boat in still water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divide first case by 20: 3/D + 2/U = 0.625

Divide second case by 21: 4/D + 3/U = 0.90

Eliminate 1/D: 3 × (4/D + 3/U) − 4 × (3/D + 2/U) = 3(0.9) − 4(0.625)

1/U = 2.7 − 2.5 = 0.2 ⇒ Upstream speed (U) = 5 km/h

3/D + 2(0.2) = 0.625 ⇒ 3/D = 0.225 ⇒ Downstream speed (D) = 13.33 km/h

Boat speed = (13.33 + 5) ÷ 2 = 9.165 ≈ 9 km/h

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Case 1: Distance downstream = 60 km, Distance upstream = 40 km, Time = 12.5 hours

Case 2: Distance downstream = 84 km, Distance upstream = 63 km, Time = 18.9 hours (as 54/60 = 0.9)

**Formula:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed | Speed of boat in still water (x) = (D + U) ÷ 2

 Boat Speed (x) = (D + U) ÷ 2
 

 

 

 
• 
 

 Downstream: x + y (Speed D)
 
• 
 

 Upstream: x − y (Speed U)

⇒ Let 1/D = a and 1/U = b

⇒ 60a + 40b = 12.5 --- (i)

⇒ 84a + 63b = 18.9 --- (ii)

⇒ Multiply (i) by 1.4: 84a + 56b = 17.5

⇒ Subtracting from (ii): (84a + 63b) − (84a + 56b) = 18.9 − 17.5

⇒ 7b = 1.4 ⇒ b = 0.2

⇒ U = 1/b = 1/0.2 = 5 km/h

⇒ 60a + 40(0.2) = 12.5 ⇒ 60a + 8 = 12.5

⇒ 60a = 4.5 ⇒ a = 0.075

⇒ D = 1/a = 1/0.075 = 13.33 km/h

⇒ Speed of boat (x) = (13.33 + 5) ÷ 2 = 18.33 ÷ 2 = 9.165 km/h

⇒ Nearest integer = 9 km/h

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Downstream and Upstream Speeds

If speed of boat is x and stream is y, then Downstream (D) = x + y and Upstream (U) = x − y.

Calculating Still Water and Stream Speed

Boat speed in still water x = (D + U) ÷ 2; Speed of stream y = (D − U) ÷ 2.

Time Conversion

To convert minutes to hours, divide by 60. Example: 54 minutes = 54/60 = 0.9 hours.</p
